statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The presentation is consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
The service is to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The service is medically necessary given the recurrent symptomatic presentation
The service directly addresses the documented need to evaluate the patient's palpitations and lightheadedness in the context of the underlying coronary artery disease
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization before services were rendered
